WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS player_count
    FROM player_college
    GROUP BY college_id
),
college_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count,
           SUM(player_count) AS total_count
    FROM college_counts
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT cc.player_count, ca.avg_count, ca.total_count
    FROM college_counts cc
    CROSS JOIN college_average ca
    WHERE cc.player_count > ca.avg_count
)
SELECT AVG(player_count) AS average_player_count,
       AVG(1.0 * player_count / total_count) AS average_fraction_of_total,
       AVG(player_count - avg_count) AS average_excess_over_all_college_average
FROM above_average;
